headline: Incredible Industries submits September quarter depository participant certificate
summary: Incredible Industries Limited has submitted its compliance certificate under Regulation 74(5) of the SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. The filing covers the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This is a routine regulatory filing confirming dematerialisation details to the stock exchange. Retail investors are unaffected by this procedural submission.
why_it_matters: No financial impact on your portfolio.
